acceptance_criteria.criterion: gui-frontend.md describes the filter/sort toolbar on the #/ route, including search, repository filter, and sort controls.
api-surface.md lists LastActivity?: string as a field on ProjectData.
api-surface.md lists updateLastActivity(projectId, lastActivity) as a public method on ProjectManager with a note that it does not modify DateModified.
rest-api.md notes that GET /api/projects/:id responses now include an optional LastActivity field.
No factual errors or references to features not implemented by the other WPs.

summary: Gap analysis: Three of five ACs were already satisfied by prior WP documentation pipelines. WP-001 docs (pipeline on WP-001-ledger) updated gui-frontend.md with full filter/sort toolbar description for the #/ route. WP-002 docs updated api-surface.md with LastActivity?: string on ProjectData and updateLastActivity() on ProjectManager. Only AC4 was outstanding.

Updated rest-api.md: added LastActivity note to the GET /api/projects/:id row — response now documents that the optional LastActivity?: string field (ISO 8601) is included when the project has recorded git activity via the polling layer, and absent on never-polled projects. Confirmed via routes/projects.ts that the handler sends the raw ProjectData object (sendJson with the getById result), so LastActivity passes through automatically.
Ran ctx generate — all 28 context files regenerated successfully, including project-manifest.md (96 KB) which now reflects the updated rest-api.md.

comments.note: ACs 1–3 were already met by the documentation pipelines run during WP-001 and WP-002. The WP-005 documentation pipeline was narrowly scoped to the one remaining gap: the REST API reference for GET /api/projects/:id. No rework of prior documentation was needed.

rest-api.md: The Projects table row for GET /api/projects/:id now explicitly documents the optional LastActivity field and its semantics (ISO 8601, present only after polling). This matches the source (ProjectData is returned verbatim by the route handler).

No factual errors found across all three target files. All references to filter/sort behaviour, LastActivity semantics, and updateLastActivity() contract are consistent with the implementations delivered by WP-001 through WP-004.
